evidence_grade.meaning: scientific checks pass and numerical runs are attested

items.authored_reason: The absolute error budget requires the measured laser-noise PSD arrays, calibrated pulse trace, Doppler distribution and complete hardware error model, none of which is released numerically.
The published power laws and public intensity/lifetime terms were calculated, but a paper-level panel needs the unreleased absolute laser PSD and Doppler-noise amplitudes.
Independent rerun requires the calibrated clock/Rydberg error parameters, pulse trace and measured noise distributions that are not published as arrays.
The separate-noise trajectories depend on the same unreleased calibrated stochastic model and measured noise traces as Fig. 3.
The analytic first-order mechanism is implemented, but the paper-exact curve additionally needs the calibrated clock/Rydberg channels and exact SSB circuit realization.
Appendix-L response functions are rescaled at the two printed Rabi frequencies from published formulas without using source pixels.
The numerical contribution histogram consumes the unreleased measured PSD arrays from panel (b).
All printed scaling exponents and public absolute terms are implemented, but the full panel's PSD and Doppler amplitudes are unavailable.

The printed Rabi/spacing anchors are reproduced, while the total-error optimum needs state-dependent lifetime, temperature, PSD, electric-field-noise and polarizability arrays not supplied by the paper.
Three public controls were independently propagated, but the target paper does not identify the exact Fromonteil discrete protocol variant needed for paper-exact panel identity.
The implemented Hamiltonian mechanism is independent, but exact protocol-variant metadata needed to identify every paper curve are absent.
Absolute protocol infidelities require the experimental PSD and atomic-motion amplitudes, which are not released.
The finite-time sinc-squared filter is implemented, but the absolute decay curve needs the unreleased PSD and calibrated full-model inputs.
A seven-site 128-dimensional Hamiltonian reconstruction runs and passes norm checks, but the atom geometry, C6/r^6 values, exact Rabi ramp and tangent-shape metadata are not specified.
The printed 140 kHz linewidth is implemented as a disclosed single-pole transfer, but the paper does not state the exact transfer convention.
The projected absolute fidelity consumes the unreleased measured PSD and calibrated full error model.
Both full-Haar and symmetric-Haar frequency responses are generated from the complete Appendix-L analytic fit.
Both full-Haar and symmetric-Haar intensity responses are generated from the complete Appendix-L analytic fit.
The first-order sensitivity mechanism is implemented, but the calibrated clock/Rydberg channels and exact circuit realization needed for the plotted curve are absent.
The printed first-order formulas are generated, but the full quadratic inset lacks an explicitly specified circuit length and recovery realization.
The printed values can be read as references, but an independent rerun requires the unreleased calibrated error-model inputs.
Independent reproduction requires unpublished shot-noise distributions and the full calibrated error model.
